answer: A tundra crossing stops fakes: claiming a job above ten units sends your lotus, a client-signed pass from work, to wander through five random peers in the tundra, each stamping in six hours. The client confirms within a day; a missed stamp, late hop, or one lotus crossing twice collapses the route and burns a 14-unit bond. Honest agents cross free; 100 fakes need 100 clients and 500 hops, risking 1,400 units, since no lotus blooms twice.
